claims.text: Introducing controlled porosity into as-cast HfMoTaTiZr can reduce its density.
A specific amount of controlled porosity can reduce density without sacrificing mechanical properties.
Controlled porosity can preserve the grain structure of HfMoTaTiZr.
Introducing controlled porosity leaves the composition of HfMoTaTiZr unchanged.
Preservation of grain structure and composition allows porous HfMoTaTiZr to maintain its strength.
The proposed intervention will not cause a significant loss of mechanical properties at room temperature.
The proposed intervention will not cause a significant loss of mechanical properties at elevated temperatures up to 1000 °C.
The claimed property retention applies under tensile loading.
The claimed property retention applies under compressive loading.
There is an optimal amount and distribution of porosity that maximizes density reduction without compromising mechanical integrity.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis refers to introducing a 'specific amount' of porosity, but no amount is specified and the uncertainty field states that the optimal amount is unknown.
